selection_criteria: Only original member train inputs; no old eval input is eligible.
Allow only the per-member family quotas recorded below, excluding constructed capacity cycles, anchors, aliases, prefetch traps, scans, serial sweeps, and artificial boundary/control families.
Require B > 1, read/write bandwidth ratio < 1000, total build pressure <= 8, and largest partition < 0.9*M.
Within each family prioritize larger actual operation count, then larger build bytes, then SHA-256(final_dataset-v2-source/ + source path) for deterministic tie-breaking.
Drop previously selected modulo-P partition streams globally; all 120 raw, operation, and partition-stream signatures must be unique.
No model, solver, or performance scores were used.
routine_interpretation: Legacy random/skewed workloads include ordinary moving hot windows, operator competition, and Markov temporal locality. They are a minority supplement to new IID large-scale random generation, not a claim that every reused case is stationary IID.
